_meta.description: Open-questions register: what is known, what is not, and how to discover the missing information — before decisions are made on the items below. Q-01…Q-50 numbering is carried from the prior register (S-PRIOR4) where the question predates this project; Q-Pxx are new here.
_meta.last_change: 2026-11-19 integration (arena/9f84489c-prod2): publication-pass questions renumbered Q-P08 (Search Console verification, cross-ref Q-P06) / Q-P09 (design-direction pick).

questions.question: Is the Associates account enrolled under tracking ID shopnow047c-20, and has each published link been validated in that account?
questions.known: The owner supplied shopnow047c-20 (brief, 2026-11-19). The format matches the documented US Store ID pattern (S-TAG). All five supplied short links resolved without a tag= (F-03). The site now publishes tagged Special Links built from verified ASINs. Whether the ID is registered and active is not observable from outside Associates Central.
questions.unknown: Account enrollment status; Partner Tag registration; whether test clicks report.
questions.how_to_discover: Owner logs into Associates Central: confirm the Partner Tag, generate or validate one Special Link per product, run a test click and read it in the report (protocol on the measurement page).

questions.question: Is the site's own trade name cleared, and does it contain an Amazon Mark?
questions.known: No Amazon Mark appears in any page title, meta description or target keyword (tools/checks.py fails the build if one does). The current wordmark is the project's established name 'Prod2' (D-P03), served under a github.io subpath — the site has no domain of its own yet.
questions.unknown: Whether a consumer-facing name (candidates in SG-01) collides with an existing trademark.
questions.how_to_discover: Re-read the Trademark Guidelines (S-POL) for domain and site names; run any candidate name through a trademark search before registering a domain.
questions.answerable_by: The owner, with a trademark search.

questions.question: Where can the self-hosted analytics endpoint run?
questions.known: analytics-endpoint/server.py is standard-library Python, counts events only (no IPs, no cookies, no referrers), and is ready to deploy. GitHub Pages cannot host it. Until a host exists, settings.analytics_endpoint stays empty and the site sends nothing.
questions.unknown: Which host the owner wants (any VM/container/Function that speaks HTTPS).
questions.how_to_discover: Owner picks a host; run the server; set the endpoint in data/p2/settings.json; rebuild. See the measurement page for the event contract.

questions.question: May the site publish prices and ratings under a dated-snapshot rule?
questions.known: Prices/ratings are currently withheld (F-02). D-19 already allows popularity claims as dated snapshots of official pages; extending that discipline to prices is an owner decision because it adds a re-verification obligation to every published page.
questions.unknown: Whether the owner wants the upkeep.
questions.how_to_discover: Decide SG-05; if yes, the checks must enforce 'price + read date' pairing.

questions.question: What is P2's exact preset/function count (24 or 25)?
questions.known: The title read 2026-11-19 says '24 One-Touch Preset Options'. Prior reads saw '24 cooking functions' and one section counting 25.
questions.unknown: The count as the manufacturer defines it.
questions.how_to_discover: Dated re-read of the listing's full spec/overview sections, or the manufacturer's product page.

questions.question: May the site ask readers for an email address, and what consent text would that need?
questions.known: The RSS feed captures readers without collecting personal data. Participation Requirement 6(g) bars rewarding clicks, so any list must stay clear of the affiliate links.
questions.unknown: Whether a list is wanted at all, and what the consent/privacy text should say.
questions.how_to_discover: Owner decision (SG-04); if yes, get the consent and privacy text reviewed before the first form ships.
questions.answerable_by: The owner, with a privacy reviewer.

questions.question: Which five events should the campaign ledger track?
questions.known: Resolved by adoption: the ledger's five defined events are impression, click, session, order, refund, each with the official attribution window from the Commission Income Statement (see measurement page). The site-side endpoint records five separate local events (page_view, outbound_click, guide_read_75, category_click, feed_click).
questions.unknown: Nothing — recorded so the definition is checkable (D-P05).

questions.question: Which question-shaped guide should be published next, and on what evidence of demand?
questions.known: The four brief-mandated guides plus two thermometer guides ship now (the accuracy guide and an instant-read vs leave-in workflow guide). Editorial hypotheses are working titles, not claims about search volume (D-19).
questions.unknown: Real query demand. No Search Console or analytics data exists yet (F-19).
questions.how_to_discover: After measurement is live: read first-party queries (Search Console + endpoint counts) for 4-6 weeks, then choose topics from measured queries (publishing cadence on the measurement page).

questions.question: Do the five submitted links continue to point at the same five products over time?
questions.known: On 2026-11-19 all five resolved to the recorded ASINs. Listings drift (titles change, variants swap, default offers change — F-44, F-49, F-29).
questions.how_to_discover: Re-run the verification pass each season or before any campaign push; record dated observations in the register.

questions.question: Should the two thermometer products get their own buying guide cluster (seasonal grilling / holiday gift angle)?
questions.known: Thermometers are half the catalog; two thermometer guides now ship (accuracy, and an instant-read vs leave-in workflow guide). A full seasonal cluster is still an editorial and SEO investment, not a data problem.
questions.unknown: Owner appetite for the extra content.

questions.question: Is any product imagery usable on the site, and through which official channel?
questions.known: The Operating Agreement Section 1 treats images as Program Content. Generated or copied photography is not an option under this project's rules (S-18, D-22).
questions.unknown: Which Amazon-served or brand-supplied images the Associates terms allow for this use, and whether the owner has a licence path.
questions.how_to_discover: Read the imagery clauses of the Operating Agreement and Program Policies with the owner's Associates contact, or ask Associates support in writing. Until then the site stays text-led.
questions.answerable_by: The account holder, with Associates support.

questions.question: Does the owner control a domain for Search Console and the analytics endpoint?
questions.known: The site is served from the GitHub Pages address wingbangboozle1-lang.github.io/Prod2. Search Console verification and a hosted endpoint both need an owner-controlled HTTPS address (SG-06).
questions.unknown: Whether a custom domain exists or is wanted, and who holds Search Console access.
questions.how_to_discover: The owner checks the domain registrar and the Search Console account. If none exists, the Pages address can be verified as a URL-prefix property.

questions.question: Which seasonal window should the first thermometer cluster target?
questions.known: The two thermometer listings describe grill and BBQ use and gift angles in their titles. No dated search or sales data exists in this project, and none is claimed.
questions.unknown: Whether any seasonal demand is real for these products, and the timing of the next season.
questions.how_to_discover: Read Search Console queries for thermometer terms after SG-06. Do not use listing titles as evidence of demand.
questions.answerable_by: The owner, from Search Console data.

questions.question: Who verifies the site in Google Search Console, and when?
questions.known: The site ships with everything Search Console needs to index it well: one canonical URL per page, unique titles and meta descriptions, sitemap.xml, robots.txt with the Sitemap line, and an RSS feed. The build is ready for the verification token (settings.json -> search_console.verification_token).
questions.unknown: Which verification method the owner prefers (HTML tag, HTML file, or DNS), and when the property will be claimed.
questions.how_to_discover: Owner opens Search Console, adds the property https://wingbangboozle1-lang.github.io/Prod2/, chooses the HTML-tag method, pastes the token into settings.json and rebuilds (or uploads the HTML file). Then submits sitemap.xml and feed.xml. Step list is on the measurement page.
questions.answerable_by: The account holder (needs the owner's Google account).

questions.question: Which of the three specified design directions should the next visual pass implement?
questions.known: The carried brief (DESIGN_PROMPT.md) specifies Direction A, warm editorial, and this build follows it. Two alternative directions are fully specified in the suggestion queue (SG-31): a clean modern shop and a bold magazine layout, each with the same compliance block. No reader data exists to choose between them (Q-P05 open).
questions.unknown: The owner's preference, and whether any brand-name change (Q-19, SG-01) should ship in the same pass.
questions.how_to_discover: Review SG-31 side by side on the suggestions page and record the pick in the decision log; the token layer (SG-33) then makes the switch mechanical.
questions.answerable_by: The site owner (taste call); Search Console data can inform it later.

questions.question: Will this publication monetise only through Associates commission, or also through API-served data and eventual hands-on testing?
questions.known: The site's outbound links carry tracking ID shopnow047c-20 and no other monetisation exists: no ads, no sponsorships, no newsletter. Price and rating display are blocked by policy without Creators/PA API access (D-P10), and hands-on claims are blocked by the fact that no product has been handled (D-06).
questions.unknown: Whether the owner will apply for Creators API access (SG-38/SG-39), whether Amazon-served product images will be used (SG-40), and whether the five products will ever be bought and tested (SG-41).
questions.how_to_discover: Answer SG-38, SG-40 and SG-41 on the suggestions page. All three are one decision each, and together they set the ceiling for how shop-like this page can lawfully become.
questions.answerable_by: The site owner (spend and account decisions).

questions.question: Which search queries does this site actually appear for, and which guide topics should follow from them?
questions.known: Nothing measured. Search Console is unverified (F-P06/D-P09), the analytics endpoint is not deployed (F-19), and the campaign ledger is empty by rule. The current nine guides and the season rotation are editorial hypotheses only (F-15).
questions.unknown: Impressions, queries, click-through, and any reader behaviour at all.
questions.how_to_discover: Owner completes Search Console HTML-tag verification, pastes the token into data/p2/settings.json, rebuilds, then exports the first 14 and 28-day query reports. After 14 days, topic choice moves to measured queries (SG-34).
questions.answerable_by: Search Console after verification; nothing else can answer it.
